# TestScript for 18-config-searchpaths
# Asserts ConfigSearchPaths single-file (first-found) mode

env HOME=$WORK/home
env SYSCONF_DIR=$WORK/etc/config-searchpaths

# 1. First-found mode: first existing search path wins, no merging
exec config-searchpaths
stdout '⚙  config-searchpaths'
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+config-searchpaths\.hcl\s+● config config-searchpaths\.hcl'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+local-region\s+● config config-searchpaths\.hcl'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+local\s+● config config-searchpaths\.hcl'

# 2. --why reports the first-found candidate and marks the remaining tiers
#    skipped, without probing them
exec config-searchpaths --why
stdout '--region\s+local-region\s+config \(config-searchpaths\.hcl\)'
stdout 'loaded: config-searchpaths\.hcl'
stdout 'home[/\\]\.config[/\\]config-searchpaths\s+skipped \(an earlier location loaded\)'
stdout 'etc[/\\]config-searchpaths\s+skipped \(an earlier location loaded\)'
! stdout 'no config file'
! stdout 'looked for:'
! stdout '██████'

# 3. First-found mode skips missing files and picks the next existing one
rm config-searchpaths.hcl
exec config-searchpaths
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+.*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]config-searchpaths[/\\]config-searchpaths\.hcl\s+● config .*config-searchpaths\.hcl'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+user-region\s+● config .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]config-searchpaths[/\\]config-searchpaths\.hcl'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+user\s+● config .*home[/\\]\.config[/\\]config-searchpaths[/\\]config-searchpaths\.hcl'

# 4. Explicit -c overrides the search list entirely
exec config-searchpaths -c etc/config-searchpaths/config-searchpaths.hcl
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+etc[/\\]config-searchpaths[/\\]config-searchpaths\.hcl\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+system-region\s+● config etc[/\\]config-searchpaths[/\\]config-searchpaths\.hcl'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+system\s+● config etc[/\\]config-searchpaths[/\\]config-searchpaths\.hcl'

# 5. No config file found at all: struct defaults apply
rm home/.config/config-searchpaths/config-searchpaths.hcl
rm etc/config-searchpaths/config-searchpaths.hcl
exec config-searchpaths
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout '--region\s+string\s+us-east-1\s+· default'
stdout '--mode\s+string\s+standby\s+· default'

-- etc/config-searchpaths/config-searchpaths.hcl --
region = "system-region"
mode = "system"

-- home/.config/config-searchpaths/config-searchpaths.hcl --
region = "user-region"
mode = "user"

-- config-searchpaths.hcl --
region = "local-region"
mode = "local"
